import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from csv file
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Select relevant columns for the visualization
selected_columns = ['Education', 'Marital_Status', 'Income', 'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'Response']

# Melt the dataframe to create a long format
melted_data = pd.melt(customer_segments, id_vars=['ID', 'Year_Birth', 'Education', 'Marital_Status'], value_vars=selected_columns, var_name='Category', value_name='Value')

# Create a heatmap using seaborn
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.set(font_scale=1.4)
g = sns.clustermap(melted_data[['Education', 'Marital_Status', 'Income', 'Value']], col_cluster=False, row_cluster=True, cmap='coolwarm', square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
plt.title('Customer Segments Clustering')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Customer ID')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()

# Create a boxplot for each category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.boxplot(data=melted_data, x='Category', y='Value', hue='Education')
plt.title('Boxplot of Customer Spending by Category')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Education')
plt.savefig('output_boxplot.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()

# Create a bar chart for each category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=melted_data, x='Category', y='Value', hue='Marital_Status')
plt.title('Bar Chart of Customer Spending by Category')
plt.xlabel('Category')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Marital Status')
plt.savefig('output_barplot.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.clf()
